S R B C & CO LLP

business_summary.text: Symbiotec Pharmalab is a steroid and hormones API maker with 60 corticosteroid and steroidal hormone APIs, 44 US DMFs and 25 CEPs, which is building biotech CDMO (fermentation) and complex injectables (dual-chamber vial) verticals.

call_points.text: New-business opex of ₹23 Cr and depreciation of ₹11 Cr a quarter should continue for the next two to three quarters.
Existing 400 kL fermentation capacity is largely booked; Phase 1 would be four times current capacity within two to three years.
First DCV ANDA filed this month; second filing scheduled for Q4FY27, with five to six more products developed.
Premarin generic launch timing is outside the company's control as the partner handles formulation development.
Contract values and exact booked capacities withheld, citing customer confidentiality; only 'multi-million dollars' per contract.
API is over 90% of revenue now and expected to fall below half in five to six years as new verticals scale.

guidance.statement: Targeting 20% revenue growth for FY27, plus or minus 5%
Targeting 25% EBITDA growth for FY27, plus or minus 5%
Capex of ₹200-250 Cr each year for the next two to three years
R&D to continue at 3-4% of sales, rising to about 5% in future

operating_notes.text: API capacity utilisation is 70-80%, with a gross block of about ₹640 Cr generating ₹800-900 Cr of revenue.
Existing 400 kL fermentation capacity is largely booked by take-or-pay contracts; Phase 1 adds 600 kL in 15-18 months.
CDMO and injectables milestone revenue was about ₹33 Cr in Q4FY26 and nil in Q1FY27.
